outgoing.name: Corrosion
outgoing.excerpt: The corrosion resistance of titanium is increased markedly by the addition of a small amount of ruthenium.

outgoing.name: Oil refinery
outgoing.excerpt: This may be useful in the removal of H2S from oil refineries and from other industrial processes.

outgoing.name: South Africa
outgoing.excerpt: Small but commercially important quantities are also found in pentlandite extracted from Sudbury, Ontario and in pyroxenite deposits in South Africa.
